lessons.title: A Teacher's Story
lessons.context: A short passage about a dedicated teacher.

paragraphs.dari: در قریه ما یک معلم زندگی می‌کرد که بچه‌ها را خیلی دوست داشت.
paragraphs.en: In our village lived a teacher who loved children very much.

paragraphs.dari: هر وقتی یک بچه به مکتب نمی‌آمد، او به خانه‌اش می‌رفت.
paragraphs.en: Whenever a child did not come to school, he would go to their house.

paragraphs.dari: او هیچ وقت شجاعتش را از دست نداد، حتی وقتی زندگی سخت بود.
paragraphs.en: He never lost his courage, even when life was hard.

paragraphs.dari: امروز خیلی از دانش‌آموزانش انسان‌های بزرگ شده‌اند.
paragraphs.en: Today many of his students have become important people.

paragraphs.dari: هر وقتی آن معلم را یاد می‌کنند، خوشحالی در چشمانشان می‌آید.
paragraphs.en: Whenever they remember that teacher, joy comes to their eyes.

questions.question: What would the teacher do if a child did not come to school?
What did the teacher never do?
What have many of his students become?
How do the students feel when they remember him?

lessons.title: Time and Memory
lessons.context: A short reflective passage about time and memory.

paragraphs.dari: زمان هیچ وقت نمی‌ایستد، همیشه به پیش می‌رود.
paragraphs.en: Time never stops, it always moves forward.

paragraphs.dari: وقتی ما کوچک بودیم، روزها خیلی طولانی به نظر می‌رسیدند.
paragraphs.en: When we were small, days seemed very long.

paragraphs.dari: حالا زمان خیلی زود می‌گذرد، این طور به نظر می‌رسد.
paragraphs.en: Now time passes very quickly, it seems like.

paragraphs.dari: با این حال، خاطره‌های خوب همیشه در دل زنده می‌مانند.
paragraphs.en: Still, good memories always stay alive in the heart.

paragraphs.dari: به همین دلیل باید قدر هر لحظه را دانست، حتی اگر کوچک باشد.
paragraphs.en: That is why every moment should be valued, even if it is small.

questions.question: How did days seem when the writer was small?
What stays alive in the heart?
What should be valued, according to the passage?
